module: "Editor Render Settings" window of the editor: lets you use graphics settings in the editor that differ from those of the game (anti-aliasing, resolution, quality of meshes/terrain/clusters/clouds, grass, shadows, dynamic reflections, SSAO, DOF, motion blur, FPS limit). Values are stored in the preferences editor.renderSettings.* (followGameSettings, values). On editor activation the game's graphics state is captured, then restored on deactivation, on editor shutdown or on extension unload.
notes: If "followGameSettings" is true (default), the game settings are used as-is; otherwise the saved values are applied on editor activation.
Some settings are only offered if the matching object exists in the scene (CloudLayer, ScreenSpaceShadowsPostFx, SSAOPostFx, DOFPostEffect, PostFxMotionBlur).

onEditorGui.desc: Draws the window: "follow game settings" checkbox, sync-from-game button, quality presets, then the sections Antialiasing, Scene Quality, Shadows, Reflections, Post-processing and FPS Limit.

onEditorRegisterPreferences.desc: Registers the "editor" category and the renderSettings subcategory (followGameSettings = true by default, values = {}).

onEditorActivated.desc: Captures the game's graphics state; if followGameSettings is false, saves and applies the editor values.

onEditorDeactivated.desc: Restores the game's graphics state captured at activation.

onEditorShutdown.desc: Same function as the game state restoration (alias).

onExtensionUnloaded.desc: Same function as the game state restoration (alias).
